baseline_like.description: Approximate previous lighter memetic behavior without incremental local search, path relinking, or hard-case multi-run.

incremental_local.description: Enable incremental-score local search and cached candidate scoring only.

incremental_plus_relink.description: Enable incremental local search plus elite path relinking, but no hard-case multi-run.

full_stack_hard_only_relink.description: Enable all requested upgrades: incremental local search, occurrence caching, hard-only path relinking, and hard-case multi-run intensification.
